content.objective: Đưa ý kiến thận trọng, không khẳng định tuyệt đối bằng seem / appear to, tend to, it would appear that, be likely to, may / might và các trạng từ rào đón.
explanation: Seem / appear + to + động từ: có vẻ như. The new drug seems to be effective. Dạng it: It seems / appears that… và trang trọng hơn: It would appear that sales are falling.
Tend + to + động từ: thường có xu hướng. Young people tend to spend more time online. Nói về xu hướng chung, không phải mọi trường hợp.
Be likely / unlikely to + động từ, It is likely that…: có khả năng. Prices are likely to rise. Modal may, might, could cũng làm giảm mức chắc chắn: The plan may cause some problems.
Trạng từ rào đón: probably, possibly, perhaps, arguably, apparently. Cấu trúc It could be argued that… dùng nhiều trong văn học thuật.
usage: Báo cáo kết quả: The results seem to suggest that the plan failed.
Nhận định xu hướng: Women tend to live longer than men.
Phản biện lịch sự: It could be argued that the policy was a mistake.

structures.label: Có vẻ
structures.pattern: S + seem / appear + to + động từ; It seems / would appear that …
structures.example: It would appear that sales are falling.

structures.label: Xu hướng
structures.example: Young people tend to spend more time online.

structures.label: Khả năng
structures.pattern: S + be likely to + động từ; It is likely that …
structures.example: Prices are likely to rise next year.

structures.label: Học thuật
structures.pattern: It could be argued / suggested that …
structures.example: It could be argued that the policy was a mistake.
